يجتاحون (form VIII)
# يَجْتَاحُونَ (yajtāḥūna) /jad͡ʒ.taː.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
# يُجْتَاحُونَ (yujtāḥūna) /jud͡ʒ.taː.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
